services.name: Airtable
services.notes: No history feed; status.json and summary.json only.

services.name: Anthropic
services.notes: Page is now status.claude.com; status.anthropic.com is the legacy name.

services.name: Apple Developer
services.notes: Response is JSONP (jsonCallback(...)); strip the wrapper before jq. Each service has events[]; an event with eventStatus != "resolved" is active.

services.name: Atlassian (umbrella)
services.notes: Umbrella page that only shows cross-product incidents. Use the per-product pages (jira, confluence, bitbucket, trello) for product incidents.

services.name: Auth0
services.notes: Endpoints use auth0.statuspage.io (page.url reports status.auth0.com; that host does not serve /api/v2).

services.name: Amazon Web Services
services.notes: One entry for all AWS services/regions. Filter by event.service (e.g. "ec2-us-east-1") or region_name. Response is UTF-16BE JSON; decode with iconv. Active events have status != "0".

services.name: Microsoft Azure
services.notes: Feed lists only active incidents (577 bytes when empty). Region and service appear in the item title/description.

services.name: Azure DevOps
services.notes: Services have a per-geography health array; filter .services[].geographies[] by health != "healthy".

services.name: Bitbucket
services.notes: Runs on the Atlassian page family; separate from the status.atlassian.com umbrella page.

services.name: Bugsnag
services.notes: Endpoints use bugsnag.statuspage.io (page.url reports bugsnag.status.smartbear.com); status.bugsnag.com did not resolve from the verifying machine.

services.name: Cloudflare
services.notes: summary.json is ~225KB because every data centre is a component, and DCs show non-operational during routine maintenance. Prefer status.json, unresolved.json, or filter summary by named products.

services.name: Datadog
services.notes: Endpoints use the vendor statuspage.io host (page.url reports status.datadoghq.com). US1 only; other Datadog sites have separate pages. status.datadoghq.com did not resolve from the verifying machine (local DNS), so only the statuspage.io host was verified.

services.name: DeepSeek
services.notes: Feed only. Entry titles are bilingual (Chinese/English).

services.name: Deno
services.notes: Instatus page. Components include "Module Registry" and deno.land; JSR itself has no separate status feed (checked jsr.io and status.jsr.io).

services.name: DigitalOcean
services.notes: Components repeat per region (hundreds of rows).

services.name: Docker Hub
services.notes: incident.io-hosted page; use status.json for the yes/no check, proxy for incident names.

services.name: ElevenLabs
services.notes: No history feed; status.json and summary.json only.

services.name: Fastly
services.notes: Feed only; /rss is ~98KB and ignores Range, so pipe through head. The human page returns 403 to non-browser clients; the feed does not.

services.name: Firebase
services.notes: Same incidents.json shape as Google Cloud.

services.name: Google Cloud
services.notes: One entry for all Google Cloud (incl. Vertex AI and Gemini API incidents). Active incidents have end == null in incidents.json; filter by service_key / currently_affected_locations.

services.name: GitHub
services.notes: Single page for all of GitHub (Copilot, Pages, Packages/GHCR and Actions are components, not separate pages).

services.name: Heroku
services.notes: Status is green/yellow/red per system (Apps, Data, Tools). Active incidents are in .incidents.

services.name: Hetzner
services.notes: Feed only (Atom, English).

services.name: Hugging Face
services.notes: Better Stack page. Read aggregate_state from the first 1KB of index.json.

services.name: Jira
services.notes: Product page for Jira Software; the umbrella page can miss product incidents.

services.name: Miro
services.notes: No history feed; status.json and summary.json only.

services.name: Mistral AI
services.notes: No history feed; status.json and summary.json only. The human page returns 403 to non-browser clients; the JSON API does not.

services.name: Modal
services.notes: Better Stack page; index.json is ~124KB, read only the first 1KB for aggregate_state.

services.name: Neon
services.notes: Status.io page.

services.name: New Relic
services.notes: Endpoints use newrelic.statuspage.io (page.url reports status.newrelic.com); the vanity domain did not resolve from the verifying machine.

services.name: OpenAI
services.notes: incident.io-hosted page; summary.json has components but no incidents array. Use status.json, then proxy for the ongoing incident names.

services.name: OpenRouter
services.notes: Feed only (no JSON API found). An empty or old feed head means no recent incidents.

services.name: Oracle Cloud
services.notes: Only status.json is available; no summary or feed verified.

services.name: PostHog
services.notes: incident.io page without the compat JSON API; feed only.

services.name: PyPI
services.notes: Page is shared with python.org, docs.python.org and mailing lists; only the pypi.org components matter for pip/uv.

services.name: Quay.io
services.notes: status.quay.io redirects to the shared Red Hat status page; look for the Quay.io component in summary.json.

services.name: Replicate
services.notes: Replicate is now on the Cloudflare status page (replicatestatus.com redirects there). Filter summary.json components for "Replicate"; the page is large.

services.name: Slack
services.notes: status endpoint returns active_incidents only; empty array means healthy.

services.name: SonarQube Cloud
services.notes: status.sonarcloud.io returned 401; this is the SonarQube page that sonarcloud links to.

services.name: Square
services.notes: No history feed; status.json and summary.json only.

services.name: Turso
services.notes: Better Stack page; index.json is ~270KB, read only the first 1KB.

services.name: Twilio and SendGrid
services.notes: SendGrid shares the Twilio page (status.sendgrid.com and status.twilio.com return identical data). summary.json is ~200KB; prefer status.json.

services.name: Vercel
services.notes: Components list includes dozens of per-region rows.

services.name: Voyage AI
services.notes: Endpoints are on the *.statuspage.io host; the vanity status domain is not used here.
